node.statement: Let S_N=sum_{k=0}^N(-T)^k in the Banach algebra B(Y). The bound sum_{k>=0}||T||^k<=1/(1-||T||) shows that (S_N) converges in B(Y) to some S with ||S||<=1/(1-||T||). The finite geometric identities (I_Y+T)S_N=S_N(I_Y+T)=I_Y-(-T)^{N+1}, followed by ||T||^{N+1}->0, give (I_Y+T)S=S(I_Y+T)=I_Y. Thus S=(I_Y+T)^{-1}, and ||T||<=1/3 gives ||S||<=3/2.
